implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/usePolicies.ts: usePolicyBundles() fetching GET /api/v1/policy/bundles. usePolicyBundle(id) single bundle with rules. usePolicyRules() fetching GET /api/v1/policy/rules for all active rules with stats. useUpdatePolicyRule() mutation. useCreatePolicyRule() mutation. useDeletePolicyRule() mutation. useReorderPolicyRules() mutation for priority changes. usePublishPolicy() mutation (POST /api/v1/policy/publish). useRollbackPolicy(snapshotId) mutation (POST /api/v1/policy/rollback). usePolicyAudit() fetching GET /api/v1/policy/audit. usePolicySnapshots() fetching GET /api/v1/policy/snapshots. useSimulatePolicy() mutation (POST /api/v1/policy/simulate). All use apiClient with auth headers.
